# Inuru

> > Inuru pioneers printed OLED technology for interactive packaging, smart wearables, and illuminated fashion through its Dragon Factory mass production facility near Berlin.

Inuru develops and manufactures flexible, printed OLED displays and lighting solutions that transform traditional products into interactive experiences. The company's Dragon Factory in Wildau, Germany represents a breakthrough in OLED mass production, enabling applications from Coca Cola marketing campaigns to pedestrian safety wearables and metaverse-connected fashion.
